RW.name: Withholding tax on dividends (15 %)
RW.statute: Law n° 027/2022 of 20/10/2022 on income tax, art. 60 1° (not amended by laws 051/2023 and 014/2025)
RW.doc: art. 60: a withholding tax of 15 % of the total amount is levied on payments by resident persons, including dividends (1°) and financial interests (2°).
unsupported: finality for individuals not stated in law 027/2022 (treated as the final tax on the payment)
dividends under art. 47 (2) and collective investment distributions

RW.name: Withholding tax on interest (15 %)
unsupported: interest on deposits of at least one year is exempt (art. 60 2° a): not distinguished

RW.name: Mandatory pension scheme, employer share (6 % = half of 12 %)
RW.statute: Prime Minister's Order n° 086/2024 art. 1 (a) (12 % from 1 January 2025; repeals PMO 009/2016) and Law n° 05/2015 art. 8 (employer and employee contribute equally)
RW.doc: PMO 086/2024 art. 1: contribution rate 12 % of the remuneration subject to contribution from 1 January 2025 (14 % from 2027, rising to 20 % in 2030); Law 05/2015 art. 8: shared equally between employer and employee.
unsupported: occupational hazards and maternity leave contributions (not modelled)
